verdict.rationale: Mem0 carries context across sessions by extracting facts from conversation turns, scoping them by user, agent, app and session, and letting the agent search them before the next request. That lets an agent resume with relevant context, but the evidence shows no actual summaries of past sessions or threads; community feedback also describes it as storing discrete facts. Missing for 10: a documented session or thread summarization feature, a way to retrieve a whole-thread recap rather than individual facts, and hands-on evidence of resuming a conversation where it left off.
